subject: Go-to-market ops handshake and service routing
messages:
From: Erica Mills <erica@acmecloud.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 04 Nov 2026 09:32:00 -0800
Subject: Partner commercial and support model for Redwood listing

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team at Acme Cloud liked how Redwood's Dedicated option can map to our managed services SKUs. Two quick asks as we prepare the marketplace listing:

- Can we get a proposed revenue split for co-sell opportunities and a simple partner-support routing diagram (who triages first, escalation path to Redwood)?
- Our procurement team needs an initial commercial summary to start internal approvals (high-level margins, contract length options).

I've attached our partner questionnaire (acme_partner_q1.docx) — mostly procurement + support questions.

Are you available next week for a 30-min handshake with our GTM + technical ops? Prefer Tue/Wed morning PT.

Thanks,
Erica Mills
Head of ISV Partnerships
Acme Cloud Consulting

Attachment: acme_partner_q1.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Erica Mills <erica@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 05 Nov 2026 11:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Partner commercial and support model for Redwood listing

Hi Erica — great to meet you too.

High level response below and I've attached a draft rev-share so your legal/finance teams have something concrete to review. Quick summary:

- Commercial: Standard partner split for co-sell introductions is 70/30 to Redwood for marketplace transacted consumption, with the option to flip to a 60/40 (partner/reed) for committed reserved capacity deals (12+ months). We can discuss a blended rate for ISV-managed offerings.
- Support routing: partners triage first using a partner portal ticket. For P1 incidents we’ll require direct Slack escalation and an assigned Redwood on-call; P2/P3 follow standard Support SLA. Ben's mapped a routing diagram he can attach.
- Procurement summary: term options (monthly usage, 12/24/36 month reserved), billing cadence, and standard termination language included in the attached.

Next steps:
1) Ben and Olga will provide the support routing map and a simple ops playbook.
2) If the commercial framework looks OK, we'll share a DocuSign-ready agreement and HubSpot deal to capture next steps.

Willing to book a Tue/Wed slot — I can do Tue 11/10 10:00 AM PT or Wed 11/11 9:30 AM PT. Which works for you?

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
Director, Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachment: draft_revshare_agreement_v1.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Erica Mills <erica@acmecloud.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 14:17:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Partner commercial and support model for Redwood listing

Thanks, Karthik — adding the routing details below and attaching the spreadsheet with entitlement SKUs.

Routing summary (ops):
- Level 1: Partner support (Acme) handles configuration and first-line troubleshooting. Ticket created in partner portal with partner tag.
- Level 2: Redwood partner ops reviews within 2 business hours for P1; 8 hours for P2.
- Escalation: if no resolution in 4 hours for P1, Redwood opens a high-priority incident and paginates SRE on-call.
- Lead routing: leads from marketplace go to Acme first if marked "partner-led"; Redwood will provide tooling to map leads to your rep IDs and pass attribution via the listing meta.

Attached: support-routing-map.xlsx (Excel) — tabs: ticket-flows, slas, sku-map.

Open question: Erica — do you require a dedicated escalation SLA (e.g., guaranteed 1-hour response for P1) as part of any premium support you plan to bundle?

- Ben
Head of Ecosystem Ops
Redwood Inference

Attachment: support-routing-map.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, Erica Mills <erica@acmecloud.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 10:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Partner commercial and support model for Redwood listing

Karthik / Ben — quick legal and procurement notes before we send anything externally. Quoting procurement here so it's visible:

- Revenue language: replace the term "transacted consumption" with "marketplace billed consumption" and add an audit clause (standard for reseller agreements).
- Data residency/PII: Acme's managed service will ingest customer telemetry. We need clarity on who owns logs, retention, and whether we will be a sub-processor for customers purchased through Acme. Please have them confirm.
- Procurement asks: FinOps wants a PO process option for reserved capacity purchases (we can accept monthly invoices or upfront PO for annual commitments).

Erica — attaching the partner onboarding form (basic fields we need completed for listing). Also, legal prefers we get a primary procurement contact for contract routing (CC'ing FinOps suggested contact below).

--
Olga Petrov
Senior Counsel, Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachment: partner-onboarding-form.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Erica Mills <erica@acmecloud.com>, Samir Shah <samir.shah@amazon.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, FinOps Group <procure@finops.example.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 16:12:00 -0800
Subject: Final alignment: go-to-market ops, commercial and next steps

Erica / Samir — thanks for the productive back-and-forth. Quick wrap and concrete next steps so we have one canonical plan:

1) Commercial: We propose the following for the initial marketplace listing (trial period through Q1):
   - Marketplace transacted: 70/30 Redwood/Acme on usage-based consumption.
   - Reserved: 60/40 Redwood/Acme for 12+ month committed capacity (standard invoice or PO accepted).

2) Support & escalation:
   - Acme will be Level 1 (partner triage). Redwood will be Level 2/3 with a P1 escalation to SRE.
   - Optional premium P1 SLA (1-hour response) can be included for a higher split or an attachable support SKU.

3) Legal / procurement: Olga will take the audit/retention language through with Acme's GC. FinOps contact (procure@finops.example.com) is on this thread for PO setup.

4) Operational: Ben will publish the support-routing map to the partner portal and provision Acme with rep IDs for lead attribution.

5) Next steps and timeline:
   - Erica to return completed onboarding form + confirmation on telemetry ownership by 11/20.
   - We will send a DocuSign agreement for signature by 11/23 if the onboarding form is in.
   - Joint launch webinar proposed for week of 12/6 — team to agree date.

HubSpot: I've created a deal record (https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/ACME-74) and attached the drafts. DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/1234ABC

Thanks all — I’ll follow up with calendar invites for the handshake session after we get the onboarding form.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Director, Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachment: final_revshare_agreement_signed.pdf (application/pdf)
